sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
PvE and PvP both improved: instead of completely redesigning the game, unpopular skills will be strengthened in place. The 【Rend】 system has become the core of the Arms kit. Rend can grow with attack power and can hit critically.
### Getting Started
- The former "punishing" specialization is now very friendly: built-in basic attack timer, 【Improved Slam】 eliminates 【Slam】 and resets the basic attack penalty
- Stance dancing: switch to 【Battle Stance】, use 【Overpower】 and immediately switch back to 【Berserker Stance】; when you need to reduce damage in the next dungeon, you can switch to 【Defensive Stance】

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### New talents
- 【Spearing Strike】: dismounts the enemy; additional 80% weapon damage to giants/dragons/mounted targets, exclusive for Arms warriors
- 【Victory Rush】: Available 20 seconds after killing non-trivial enemies, causing damage and recovering 10% of maximum health (common to all warriors)
- 【Weaponmaster】: The four series of axe/sword/pole/hammer are combined into one, and the staff is also included; hammers and staffs ignore armor, and weapons can be switched more freely
- 【Breath of Blood】: Give 【Rend】 a chance to activate 【Overpower】 for 6 seconds. The more points, the higher the probability.
- 【Improved Slam】: Reduces the casting time of 【Slam】 and no longer interrupts basic attacks.
### Changes to existing skills
- 【Slam】: Added 15 seconds cooldown
- 【Rend】: Grows better with stronger attacks, and can hit critically
- 【Thunder Clap】: Attack speed reduction effect 10% → 20%
- 【Deep Wounds】: Can hit critically
- 【Battle Shout】: Lasts 2 → 3 minutes; 【Demoralizing Shout】: 30 seconds → 45 seconds
- 【Retaliation】: CD 30 → 15 minutes, no longer shares cooling with 【Shield Wall】, 【Recklessness】
- 【Shield Wall】: CD 30 → 15 minutes; damage reduction 75% → 60%
- 【Hamstring】 Probability stun no longer relies on prayer - 【Spearing Strike】 directly knocks the enemy off his horse

sections.title: Pros & cons
sections.markdown:
### Advantages
- Strong battlefield mobility (【Charge】/interception)
- Charged Rage + 【Sweeping Strikes】 + Cleave Burst AoE
- 【Improved Hamstring】 can control enemies easily
### Disadvantages
- Easily become angry and lose food when missed/parried
- Sluggish AoE combat for long periods of time (limited rage generation)
- Less passive self-healing methods than other specializations

sections.title: Races
sections.markdown:
### Race selection (all races can be played, with minimal differences)
- Alliance · Night Elf (PvE first choice): The critical hit initiative and the critical hit bleed are excellently linked - 【Elune's Light】【Shadowmeld】【Quickness】【Wisp Spirit】
- Alliance · Gnome (PvE/PvP balance): Active buffs can be stacked into bursts; rage limit and control-free are both practical - 【Eureka!】【Expansive Mind】【Escape Artist】【Engineering Specialization】
- Alliance · Human (PvP only): stun relief + anti-invisibility; ruthless critical strikes are also available in PvE——【Will to Survive】【Perception】【Ruthless】【The Human Spirit】
- Alliance · Dwarves: 【Craftsman Precision】 【Big Game Hunter】【Stoneform】【Find Treasure】
- Horde · Orcs (Best): Suitable for both PvE/PvP (Burst + Control Reduction/Counter) - 【Bloodrage】 【Command】 【Hardiness】【Shatter Curse】
- Horde · Troll (second choice): 【Berserk】【Beast Slaying】【Regeneration】【Rapid Regeneration】
- Horde · Tauren: low damage but solid tankiness and control, good leveling experience——【War Stomp】【Endurance】【Plainsrunning】【Cultivation】
- Horde · Undead (weaker): Will overlaps with the fear immunity that comes with the warrior——【Will of the Forsaken】【Cannibalize】【Water Breathing】【Touch of the Grave】
- Tianyi: A more leveling experience, but a weak ending——【Walk on Air】【Skysight】【Elemental Insight】【Wind Blessed】【Read Ley Line】

sections.title: Professions
sections.markdown:
- Engineering: The best in end-game PvE/PvP (devices and bombs). The value during the leveling period is limited. It is recommended to change after reaching the full level.
- Mining: node increase + smelting 1-300 replenishing skills; campfire gain (to be tested) very suitable for warriors (does not stack with 【Blessing of Might】)
- Blacksmithing: New formulas can be leveled up to create stronger equipment, which can be sold to recoup the cost; campfire gain (to be tested) is also of high quality (not superimposed with 【Strength of Earth Totem】)
- Recommended route: leveling mining + forging, change to engineering after reaching full level; engineering bonfire benefits are limited (to be tested), engineering is not recommended during the leveling period.

sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
The cycle and talents generally continue to be classic, but the underlying situation has changed a lot: anger is normalized (a fixed formula gives anger and no longer grows with equipment/crits), world buffs are removed, and boss armor is increased - the damage of the team is under pressure, and team configuration (such as 【Windfury Totem】, 【Leader of the Pack】) is more important than ever.
### Getting Started
- Deep anger management
- Single player leveling is weak, more suitable for team content

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### Core mechanism changes
- Rage normalization: Attacks give a fixed range of anger, critical hits no longer give extra anger; the more damage you take, the more anger you can get.
- The armor breaking of 【Faerie Fire】 and 【Curse of Recklessness】 no longer stacks - the purely physical 【Fury】 battle is further limited
### New talents
- 【Rage Attack】: 【Whirlwind】 hits with two weapons at the same time, the off-hand participates in AoE, and the off-hand choice is wider
- 【Victory Rush】: Level 20 skill, available after kill, medium damage + small amount of blood recovery
- 【Tactical Mastery】: Retain a small amount of anger when changing posture (basic skill)
### Changes to existing skills
- 【Bloodthirst】: Damage coefficient 45% → 35% attack power, a small amount of fixed damage added
- 【Fury】: Triggered by any direct damage, no longer requires critical hit
- 【Dual Wield Specialization】: Off-hand +10% hit (to compensate for the removal of the "next attack" miss penalty)
- Enhanced 【Battle Shout】 talent is removed, team assistance is reduced; 【Recklessness】 is still 30 minutes CD (compared to 3 minutes of 【Berserk】)

sections.title: Pros & cons
sections.markdown:
### Advantages
- Low target cleave unparalleled: The combination of 【Cleave】 and 【Whirlwind】 is extremely powerful
- Explosion at critical moments CD: 【Death Wish】
- Plate armor has high HP and excellent survivability
### Disadvantages
- High dependence on equipment, requiring a large amount of equipment to meet the standards
- 【Recklessness】 30-minute large CD limits burst frequency

sections.title: Races
sections.markdown:
### Race selection
- Alliance · Night Elf (Domination Level): Powerful critical strike active + movement speed——【Elune's Light】【Quickness】【Wisp Spirit】
- Alliance · Gnome (Solid): Damage initiative can be stacked into Death Wish's burst; control control is the icing on the cake - 【Eureka!】【Escape Artist】【Expansive Mind】
- Alliance · Human/Celestial (Holy Order): niche choice; dwarves are relatively weak - 【Will to Survive】【Perception】【Ruthless】/【Walk on Air】【Wind Blessed】
- Horde · Orc (Best): Burst Active + Stun Reduction + Strong Magic Resistance——【Bloodrage】 【Command】 【Hardiness】【Shatter Curse】
- Horde · Troll/Undead: The strength is usable, the adaptability is slightly lower, but each has its own strengths; Skyborn are valuable in fighting elemental bosses; Tauren prefer to survive——【Berserk】【Beast Slaying】【Rapid Regeneration】【Touch of the Grave】【Will of the Forsaken】【Cannibalize】【Endurance】【Elemental Insight】

sections.title: Professions
sections.markdown:
- Engineering: It is expected to still be a strong major in Fury Battle - powerful props and explosives complement the burst and maneuverability, especially in single brushing.
- Alchemy: The duration and strength of mixtures/potions are increased, and the attribute gains are considerable

sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
The first choice tank with the most comprehensive tools in the classic era, the changes in the unlimited server are minimal but enough to change the gameplay: the threat coefficient is directly added to the talent (【Defiance】), 【Revenge】 adds attack strength - the pain point of the "violent tank" in the classic era is solved head-on, and the sword and shield gameplay returns.
### Getting Started
- 【Thunder Clap】 【Defensive Stance】 is available + 【Charge】 can also be used after being gifted - it can be an effective tank even if you don't know how to dance.
- Don’t use 【Heroic Strike】 when you are not angry enough (it takes up basic attack); give priority to the damage/threat of 【Sunder Armor】 and 【Revenge】
- Multi-target threat management is still the focus of learning; being hit/absorbing damage will generate anger, and you will no longer be in a hurry when tanking multiple monsters.
### Exclusive mechanism
- Source of anger: basic attack, attack, 【Charge】, 【Bloodrage】; block/dodge/parry by 【Shield Specialization】 and 【Master of Defense】 to generate anger - anger distribution is the core of playing a good warrior
- 【Battle Stance】: Threat -20%; key skills 【Retaliation】, 【Overpower】, 【Execute】, 【Charge】
- 【Berserker Stance】: critical hit +3%, damage +10%; key skills 【Recklessness】, 【Whirlwind】, 【Intercept】, 【Execute】
- 【Defensive Stance】: Injury -10%, damage -10%, threat +30% (protection base posture); key skills 【Shield Wall】, 【Shield Block】, 【Disarm】
- There are many posture macros entering and exiting scenes; 【Tactical Mastery】 is basic to make posture switching easier, and the weapon tree 【Improved Tactical Mastery】 can further retain anger.

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### New skills and talents
- 【Victory Rush】: 10% blood recovery after killing (battery life badly needed for leveling)
- 【Vanguard】: Defense stance available 【Charge】
- 【Fortified City】: All damage +10% when holding a shield
- 【Master of Defense】: Dodge/parry generates 5 rage while holding a shield
- 【Focus of Fury】: Offensive skills cost -3
- The protection talent tree has been completely reworked, with much wider methods than the classic one.
### Changes to existing skills
- 【Thunder Clap】: Defensive posture available; attack speed reduced by 10% → 20%; CD 4 seconds → 6 seconds - with 【Cleave】 under abundant anger, the multi-target tank experience will be qualitatively changed
- 【Shield Block】: Block +75% for 7 seconds, can be blocked 2 times (original 5 seconds/1 time)
- 【Shield Wall】: Total damage -60% for 12 seconds, CD 30 → 15 minutes and can be further reduced by talents
- 【Tactical Mastery】: Basic skills (retain 10 anger regardless of posture)
- 【Precision】: 100% generate 5 Fury when blocking (original 1 Fury)
- 【Anticipation】: Defense skill +10 → +20
- 【Improved Bloodrage】: 【Bloodrage】 anger generation +50%
- 【Improved Revenge】: changed to 【Revenge】 damage +60% (original 15% chance of stun)
- 【Defiance】: When holding a shield, all threats in defensive posture will be increased by 15%
- 【Improved Disarm】: Disarm CD -20 seconds; 【Improved Shield Wall】: 【Shield Wall】 CD -11 minutes

sections.title: Pros & cons
sections.markdown:
### Advantages
- Comprehensive skills: single/multi-target threats, damage reduction, and control relief.
- After 【Thunder Clap】 enters a defensive posture, the pressure of multi-target monster pulling and hatred is greatly relieved.
### Disadvantages
- The means of breaking threats is still weaker than that of legal tanks (remote pulling of monsters relies on engineering props)
- Anger management is still a threshold in high-pressure situations

sections.title: Races
sections.markdown:
### Race selection (all races are available, each with its own strengths)
- Alliance · Humanity: After the critical hit rolling bleed became a feasible talent, the benefit of Ruthless 1% critical hit was amplified——【Ruthless】【Will to Survive】
- Alliance · Dwarves: Craftsman's Accuracy +1% hit is not on the same axis as human critical hit, but the bleeding (cannot be dispelled) scene is very strong - 【Craftsman's Accuracy】 【Stoneform】【Big Game Hunter】
- Alliance · Gnome (PvP only): Active buffs can be stacked into Death Wish; control relief comes with short-term immunity (like Free Blessing) - 【Eureka!】【Escape Artist】
- Alliance · Night Elf: The conflict between critical strike initiative and reckless 100% critical strike, don’t open them both——【Elune's Light】【Quickness】【Wisp Spirit】
- Horde · Orcs (the most comprehensive): No need to choose a partner for an explosion; magic reduction/curse removal and control reduction are all hard defenses - 【Command】 【Bloodrage】【Shatter Curse】【Hardiness】
- Horde · Tauren (stronger defense): solid health bonus; easy to use for group stun leveling/dungeon——【Endurance】【War Stomp】【Plainsrunning】
- Horde · Troll: It is very practical to recover blood after active self-healing and fear-based skills——【Rapid Regeneration】【Beast Slaying】【Berserk】
- Horde · Undead: blood-sucking triggers frequently; willpower is practical at both ends——【Touch of the Grave】【Will of the Forsaken】【Cannibalize】
- Tianyi (plain): Increases damage to elements in scenes; Haste has always been low in protection - 【Elemental Insight】【Walk on Air】【Wind Blessed】

sections.title: Professions
sections.markdown:
- Engineering: has always been a strong profession for tanks - the remote grenade can deal with threats and solve the problem of the distance between tanks and monsters.
- The other majors each have attribute bonuses, and which one is better remains to be tested; it is recommended to start with mining + forging (or mining + engineering)

sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
New group healing methods, holy seals and blessings have been added to make it easier to manage. Damage skills have been added during the leveling period - the skills are more complete and focus is put back on the operation itself.
### Getting Started
- The core is simple, with sufficient self-healing, excellent defense, acceptable damage, and very smooth leveling
- The only threshold: There are many types of blessings/halos/sacred seals, and it takes time to familiarize yourself with which one to use in each scene.
### Exclusive mechanism: Seal and Judgment
- Only one holy seal can be activated at the same time; the effect of 【Judgement】 changes with the current holy seal (light = the attacker returns blood, wisdom = the attacker returns mana, crusade = the target receives increased holy damage, justice = attack brings holy damage)
- The 【Judgement】 effect on the target will be refreshed by your basic attack; the target's judgment does not have to be consistent with the current holy seal - for example: turn on 【Seal of Light】 Judgment Boss to let the whole team attack to restore health, and then switch to 【Seal of Wisdom】 to restore mana to your own basic attack and refresh the light judgment on the target.
- When dealing damage, you can use 【Judgement】 with 【Seal of the Crusader】 and then use 【Seal of Righteousness】 to eat Crusaders to increase damage.

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### New skills
- 【Light's Vigil】: The new pinnacle of the sacred tree, the core of group healing - imposes a 30-second watch on the target. Next time 【Holy Shock】 triggers the whole team to heal each other (causing sacred damage to the enemy) and returns 75% of the mana consumption; limited to one per team
- 【Holy Strike】: Instant strike, 40% weapon damage + holy damage (leveling damage supplement)
- 【Voice of Truth】: 6 seconds immune to silence and interruption
### Existing changes
- Blessing duration 5 minutes → 1 hour (【Blessing of Wisdom】, etc.) - The era of 5 minutes for the whole team to receive blessings is over
- 【Judgement】: No longer consumes the currently activated Holy Seal

sections.title: Races
sections.markdown:
### Race selection
- Alliance · Humans (recommended)/Dwarves: Humans have ruthless 1% critical hit, dwarf craftsman precision +1% hit (humans have another spiritual passive); dwarves have strong removal methods, but knights have their own means of removal - 【Ruthless】【The Human Spirit】/【Craftsman Precision】 【Stoneform】
- Horde · Undead (only optional): 【Touch of the Grave】【Will of the Forsaken】【Cannibalize】

sections.title: Professions
sections.markdown: - Blacksmithing (self-made equipment) + engineering (functional props); both consume ores - if you don’t plan to buy all the ores, just choose one to match with mining

sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
A tank with comprehensive skills, the only shortcoming is that it does not have a taunting skill like 【Taunt】 - now there is: 【Judgement】 of 【Seal of Fury】 can taunt the target for 4 seconds. The problem of recovering mana during battle has also been solved by talent, and the experience has been transformed.
### Getting Started
- One of the simplest tanks; focus on familiarizing yourself with the linkage between each holy seal and 【Judgement】, and make good use of 【Holy Strike】, 【Consecration】, and level 40 【Holy Shield】
### Exclusive mechanism: Mana and Holy Seal
- The Knight is the only tank that uses blue: there will be no shortage of resources at the beginning, but in the protracted battle, it is necessary to control the blue. After a wave, you often need to sit down and return to blue before pulling the next wave.
- 【Seal of Wisdom】: Normal attack returns mana; after trial, the team attacks the target and returns mana
- 【Seal of Light】: Basic attacks restore blood; after the trial, the whole team attacks the target to restore blood.
- 【Seal of the Crusader】: Acceleration and attack power (reduces click damage); Judgment increases the target's holy damage
- 【Seal of Justice】: probability of dizziness; trial to prevent escape
- 【Seal of Fury】: Damage + Absorption Shield; Judgment Taunt
- 【Seal of Righteousness】: Each hit causes Holy damage; Judgment direct damage
- Cutting the holy seal according to the scene and coordinating the judgment effect on the target with the team are the homework of anti-riding

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### New skills and talents
- 【Seal of Fury】: Basic attack adds sacred damage, and when holding a shield, each attack will gain an equal amount of 50% absorbed shield; Judgment Taunt for 4 seconds
- (To be tested): Absorption shield = 100% maximum health, lasting 8 seconds (self-discipline 1 minute); the only percentage damage reduction CD of anti-riding relies on it
- 【Holy Strike】: 42% weapon damage + holy damage instant strike
- (To be tested): Stamina +4%, Holy Shield/Holy Protection/Temple Barrier CD -60 seconds
- (To be tested): When the Seal of Wrath absorption shield is full, 60 mana will be returned.
- (To be tested): End the trial CD immediately, and the next trial will be free of mana.
- (To be tested): 【Holy Strike】 threat +30%; additional -15% damage for 6 seconds under Righteous Wrath
### Existing changes
- 【Consecration】: The damage is greatly reduced, but the first 4 targets in the circle are additionally damaged - the AoE tanking ability is in line with the target limit of the warrior/wild druid.
- 【Holy Shield】: Block +30% → +20%, damage back 130 → 221
- 【Redoubt】: Triggered by violence → 10% probability of triggering by melee damage
- 【Anticipation】: Defense skill +10 → +20
- 【Precision】: Hit +1% → Hit +1% (the value remains unchanged, only the description caliber is modified)
- 【Improved Righteous Fury】: 【Righteous Fury】 Threat +50% → Injury -6%
- 【Shield Specialization】: Shield absorption +30% remains unchanged, blocking 100% returns 6% of maximum mana (once within 3 seconds)
- 【One-Handed Weapon Specialization】: One-handed weapon damage +6% → +10%
- 【Reckoning】: Extra attack when hit → 40% block when hit / 100% extra attack when hit by non-periodic critical hit

sections.title: Races
sections.markdown:
### Race selection
- Alliance · Humanity (preferred): After the spell can critically hit, the 1% critical hit benefit of Ruthless is amplified; stun is removed every 3 minutes, double-ended utility - 【Ruthless】【Will to Survive】
- Alliance · Dwarves (can be overtaken in scenes): Craftsman Accuracy +1%, the hit is not on the same axis as human critical strike, but the bleeding relief (cannot be dispelled) is very strong in certain scenes - 【Craftsman Accuracy】 【Stoneform】【Big Game Hunter】
- Horde · Undead (unique): blood-stealing triggers frequently, and willpower is practical at both ends; corpse-eating brings back mana, which is good news for knights——【Touch of the Grave】【Will of the Forsaken】【Cannibalize】

sections.title: Professions
sections.markdown:
- Engineering: Since the classics, the knight's long-range monster pulling problem has been solved by engineering grenades, which will probably still be strong.
- The other majors each have attribute bonuses, which one remains to be seen; it is recommended to start with mining + forging (or mining + engineering)

sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
The Punisher Cavalry, which has been weak and lacks recognition for a long time, has received a comprehensive overhaul: a reworked talent tree, new skills, and substantial enhancements to existing skills. Positioning = mid-to-high damage + powerful support (blessing/halo/functional spell), can be a tank/treater when necessary.
### Exclusive mechanism: Holy Light Twist
- A simplified version of the classic master's "Sacred Seal Twist": no need to adjust the rhythm of the basic attack, just cut the holy seal to get the echo - 【Twist of Light】 makes each basic attack stable with double holy seals
- The official built-in basic attack timer assists this gameplay; players have different opinions on its de-rhythmization, and the strength needs to be measured in practice.

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### New skills and talents
- 【Holy Strike】: Instant holy damage main attack skill, similar to Crusader Strike
- 【Twist of Light】: The new pinnacle of the Punishment Tree - "Twist Seal": When switching Seals, the old Seal turns into "Echo", and the next basic attack will have the effects of both old and new Seals at the same time (one basic attack with two Seals)
- 【Seal of Fury】: Tank Seal, 【Judgement】 can taunt for 4 seconds (shared with anti-riders)
### Existing changes
- 【Blessing of Wisdom】, 【Blessing of Might】, 【Blessing of Kings】: Blessing duration is 1 hour; the king can be obtained by training instead
- 【Lay on Hands】: No longer interrupts mana recovery
- 【Consecration】: Extra damage to the first 4 targets; available through training instead
- 【Holy Wrath】: Stun undead/demon for 2 seconds
- 【Righteous Fury】: Threat +60% → +90%
- 【Shadow Resistance Aura】, 【Frost Resistance Aura】, 【Fire Resistance Aura】: The resistance aura extends from the team to the entire group
- 【Judgement】: No longer consumes holy seals

sections.title: Pros & cons
sections.markdown:
### Advantages
- Average single target damage, solid AoE
- The auxiliary ability of blessing/halo/function spell is the core value
- Good mobility (Cleaning Technique + 【Blessing of Freedom】)
- 【Lay on Hands】 and 【Blessing of Protection】 came back at the critical moment
### Disadvantages
- Missing a big damage CD
- The blue pool is small and easy to bottom out
-Eat equipment: very dependent on stacking spell power
- Cut talents to be effective in tanking/healing

sections.title: Races
sections.markdown:
### Race selection
- Alliance · Human (recommended): The overall racial strength exceeds that of the dwarves——【Will to Survive】【Perception】【Ruthless】【The Human Spirit】
- Alliance · Dwarves: 【Stoneform】【Find Treasure】 【Craftsman Precision】 【Big Game Hunter】
- Horde · Undead (only): 【Touch of the Grave】【Water Breathing】【Cannibalize】【Will of the Forsaken】

sections.title: Professions
sections.markdown: - Current consensus: Mining + Blacksmithing is a strong choice for the Punishment Cavalry

sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
The main body has not changed much, and the focus is entirely on pets: pets will grow with the hunter's attributes, and each pet will gain new skills. The new skill 【Summon Hawk】 is a "pseudo second pet".
### Getting Started
- The three series are the easiest to use; the key is to keep the two layers of 【Summon Hawk】 from falling and not refresh prematurely
- Hunters have a high ceiling: melee combat, trap and spike control, pet and environment control are all worth practicing.

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### New talents
- 【Summon Hawk】: The eagle dive bombs the target and continues to attack for 18 seconds, up to 2; shared CD with 【Arcane Shot】
- 【Focused Fire】: When the pet is activated, all damage done by you and your pet +2%
### Body and pet changes
- 【Auto Shot】: Removed hidden 0.5 second cast time and can continue during other skill casts - stronger kiting ability
- 【Aimed Shot】 and 【Multi-Shot】 share cooldown; 【Aimed Shot】 is changed to a basic skill
- 【Endurance Training】: Pet health and armor +15%
- 【Improved Aspect of the Monkey】: 【Aspect of the Monkey】 dodge +6%, and pets gain 50% effect
- 【Intimidation】: Next attack will stun for 3 seconds and 100% critical hit, high threat
- 【Bestial Discipline】: Pet focus recovery +20%; 50% mana recovery retained when casting
-Pet growth: 2 life/1 stamina, armor 30%, attack power 10%, critical hit 100% inheritance; new avoidance, no longer eats other people's gains; each pet family has at least one exclusive skill (【Dust Cloud】 PvE armor breaking, 【Dismember】 PvP healing interruption, 【It's mine!】 Counter stalker opening, etc.)

sections.title: Pros & cons
sections.markdown:
### Advantages
- 【Bestial Wrath】 window period burst high
- Strong kiting ability (both PvE/PvP)
- Pets have various functions and can be switched as needed
### Disadvantages
- Does not bring any team benefits, relies on hard damage to make money
- 8-yard blind zone: you can’t hit anyone at close range

sections.title: Races
sections.markdown:
### Race selection
- Tian Yi: If there are elemental monsters on the field, you will reach the top; the rapid passive is scarce in the classic period, and the income may be higher——【Elemental Insight】【Wind Blessed】【Walk on Air】【Skysight】【Read Ley Line】
- Alliance · Night Elf (Strong): Critical hits are automatically combined with Rapid Fire/Wild Fury into the burst window. The shorter the battle, the higher the benefits; pets also receive critical hits - 【Elune's Light】【Shadowmeld】【Quickness】【Wisp Spirit】

sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
In the infinite server, the positioning of survival hunting has been changed from "harassment" to a mixed output of "melee + trap": a batch of melee-oriented talents have been added to the second half of the talent tree, and two old talents have been merged into one. Pets have also been changed to inherit part of the hunter's attribute growth, and more pet families have become available due to new skills.
### Getting Started
- Easy to get started: Survival in the three series is equally easy to get started, but due to the limitation of talent points, it does not become effective until about level 32.
- Pets are optional: you can play with or without pets.
- High ceiling: The full set of long-range and melee skills are very difficult to deal with once you are familiar with them; the control of traps and spikes is your strength in PvP, and the control of pets and environment allows you to do things alone that other professions cannot do - this is common to all three systems.
### Ammunition and Arrows
The ammunition system has not changed substantially: it still requires a quiver or ammunition pouch, so it has one less backpack slot than other professions.
### Pets
All pet families now have at least one unique skill, some are PvE-focused, and some are strong in PvP; pets will also inherit some attributes of hunters:
- Stamina: The player gives the pet 2 points of life for every 1 point of stamina.
- Armor: Inherit 30% of the player's armor
- Attack Power: Inherits 10% of the player's highest attack power source
- Critical hit: Inherits the player’s critical hit rate in full
These values are visible in the Pets tab of the character panel. Pets now have avoidance, but no longer enjoy the benefits of other professions.

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### New talents
- 【Strider Kick】: Melee kick that deals 100% melee damage and increases movement speed for 3 seconds, 8 second cooldown - does not interrupt casting.
- 【Predator's Edge】: Melee critical hit damage +30%, off-hand weapon damage +50% - the off-hand bonus is very strong compared to other dual-wielding professions.
- 【Expose Prey】: There is a 10% chance to activate 【Mongoose Bite】 for 5 seconds when attacking a target with the Hunter's Mark - with this, 【Mongoose Bite】 can enter the loop without relying on dodge.
- 【Easy】: The mana consumption of traps and melee skills is -60%, and critical hits have a chance to increase mana recovery for 30 seconds - the core talent to maintain the blue bar.
- 【Survival Expert's Discipline】: The cooldown of traps and "intimidation" is -40% - simple and effective; the basic cooldown of traps in the infinite server has been extended to 30 seconds.
- 【Male Strike】: The pinnacle talent of survival, which makes the target hit by 【Mongoose Bite】 continue to bleed for a long time.
### Changes to existing skills and talents
- 【Mongoose Bite】: Changed to calculate based on weapon damage (including fixed bonus), no longer a fixed damage; unless 【Expose Prey】 is clicked, you still need to dodge before using it.
- 【Improved Tracking】: Monster tracking and human tracking are combined into one talent. The damage to tracking type targets is +5% at full level, and it is effective for all tracking skills of hunters.
- 【Entrapment】: When the trap is triggered, the affected target will be immobilized for up to 5 seconds at full level.
- 【Survival Tactics】: The two classic talents of "Trap Hit" and "Fake Death Hit" are merged into one.
- 【Counterattack】: Can be used after parrying the opponent's attack; it will grow with the weapon damage instead of fixed damage.

sections.title: Pros & cons
sections.markdown:
The goal of Unlimited Server is to make every spec available. Survival Hunter does not have any team benefits, and relies on 【Dust Cloud】 to provide a little armor penetration at most, so whether it can be ranked depends entirely on the damage itself.
In terms of PvP, as long as the pet is not killed, it will be interesting - some pet families have obtained strong PvP skills; the movement speed increase that comes with 【Strider Kick】 is particularly useful, and the trap talents have also become stronger overall.
### Advantages
- Excellent continuous damage: You can almost always press the skill. In the classic version, the "no empty window" itself is strength.
- Strong kiting ability: Kite can be flown in both PvE and PvP, as long as the opponent does not have remote control or dash means.
- Pet belt function: New pet skills give each family room to play - 【Dust Cloud】 is strong in PvE, 【Dismember】 is powerful in PvP healing, 【It's mine! 】 Can counterattack when the Rogue strikes first.
### Disadvantages
- No team benefits: There are no benefits that are useful to the team. In the competitive environment, you have to rely on high basic damage to gain position.
- Competition for equipment is fierce: weapons must be competed with warriors, rogues (and possibly paladins).

sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
The classic group brushing skeleton (healing/【Greater Heal】/quick healing/restoration/prayer of healing) is retained, and new blood-removing methods and mana return rewards for hand-changing spells are added; the old talent/race thresholds are removed (【Fear Ward】 for all priests, 【Divine Spirit】 for training).
### Getting Started
- Friendly to newcomers: good early survival, solid output, and can be beaten in the leveling dungeon.
### Exclusive mechanism: Priest racial spells
- Same commandments: one for each level 10/20 - human 【Divine Grace】 / 【Feedback】; dwarf 【Desperate Prayer】 / 【Smite】; dark night 【Starshards】 / 【Elune's Grace】; dwarf 【Confounding Flash】 / 【Contingency Plan】; undead 【Touch of Weakness】 / 【Dark Sacrifice】; Troll 【Hex of Weakness】/【Shadowguard】

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### New skills and talents
- 【Binding Heal】: New holy talent - 1.5 seconds to heal friendly targets and yourself at the same time, low threat
- 【Prayer of Mending】: Apex of the Sacred Tree - When the target is injured or receives non-periodic treatment, it will trigger healing and jump to teammates within 20 yards, up to 5 times, limited to one per person
- 【Divine Grace】: New racial spell for humans - Instantly heals allies below 50% health and removes weak souls (cannot target self, 10 minute CD; humans no longer have 【Desperate Prayer】)
- 【Contingency Plan】: New dwarf racial spell - 30-second guard, absorb + continuous treatment when the target falls below 35% health (10-minute CD)
### Existing changes
- 【Fear Ward】: Level 20 all-priest training (originally exclusive for dwarves); CD/duration are 3 minutes each
- 【Divine Spirit】: Available through level 30 training, no longer locked to discipline talent; top level lasts for 1 hour
- 【Spirit of Redemption】: Duration 10 → 15 seconds
- 【Prayer of Healing】: Range 30 → 40 yards
- 【Power Word: Fortitude】: Top lasts 30 minutes → 1 hour
- Removed: Healing Focus/Enhanced 【Prayer of Healing】/Well of Light; Added: Linked Healing/Prayer of Healing/Prayer of Light

sections.title: Pros & cons
sections.markdown:
### Advantages
- Comprehensive treatment methods: direct treatment/restoration/shield/group brushing + blood removal combined treatment and 【Prayer of Mending】
- Strong team gain: 【Power Word: Fortitude】 and 【Divine Spirit】 are both available for training and are 1 hour long
- Dispelling and functions: Exorcism/Disease abolition/All races 【Fear Ward】/After death 【Spirit of Redemption】
### Disadvantages
- Cloth armor has low HP and is a target in melee combat.
- Poor mobility: Most treatments require standing, and only recovery and shielding are available while moving.
- Eat mana: Prayer of Light will return mana when changing spells, but mana will still be lost after repeating a single spell.

sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
One of the biggest beneficiaries of the development team's philosophy of "promoting unpopular specs": a batch of changes that directly address the usability of the raid, while retaining Shadow's core identity. In the classic era, the positioning of "bringing a shadow priest means working for a warlock" has been rewritten.
### Getting Started
- Friendly to newbies (same as Discipline/Holy): good for survival during leveling, has healing and output capabilities, and can be farmed and beaten in the dungeon
### Exclusive mechanism: Priest racial spells
-Same precepts: one for level 10/20 - human 【Divine Grace】/【Feedback】; dwarf 【Desperate Prayer】/【Smite】; dark night 【Starshards】/【Elune's Grace】; dwarf 【Confounding Flash】/【Contingency Plan】; undead 【Touch of Weakness】/ 【Dark Sacrifice】; Troll 【Hex of Weakness】/【Shadowguard】

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### New skills and talents
- 【Shadow Word: Death】: Level 32 basic skill, a weapon for killing low-health enemies - triggers 【Spirit Tap】 to restore mana; equipped with 2 points 【early death】 to become a strong execution cycle skill with a CD of 15 seconds
- 【Dark Sacrifice】: Undead priest racial spell, blood to blue similar to 【Life Tap】 (15 seconds, 10 minutes CD) - a natural fit with the skill set of the shadow priest
- 【Contingency Plan】: Dwarf priest racial spell, which can be used for external defense (whether it can be used under 【Shadowform】 needs to be confirmed)
### Existing changes
- 【Devouring Plague】: Basic, CD 3 minutes → 1 minute (originally exclusive to the undead)
- 【Shadowform】: Major changes - Shadow damage +15% → +10%, but shadow spells cost -50% mana, and shadow critical damage +100%; only healing spells are prohibited, and the shadow form can be used for sacred damage/functional spells without losing the form; physical damage taken -15% unchanged
- 【Vampiric Embrace】: 1 minute CD lasting 30 seconds; triggered when the affected enemy dies 【Spirit Tap】 - a stable offload trigger method in team situations
- 【Shadow Wave】: No longer increases the target's shadow damage, but instead increases the caster's own shadow damage - the old positioning of "bringing a shadow priest to the whole group" is retired and returns to personal output.

sections.title: Pros & cons
sections.markdown:
### Advantages
- Single-player PvP methods are still strong and this will not change
- The new mana recovery method directly addresses the mana consumption pain point of shadow priests.
- New positioning of execution damage: 【Shadow Word: Death】 + 【Early death】 Quickly kill enemies with less than 20% health
### Disadvantages
- The usability of the group book is still to be tested: the old team value is replaced by individual output, and the quality is unknown
- Healing spells cannot be cast in shadow form, and there is no way to protect teammates during the disadvantage period.
- Shadow recognition comes late in the leveling period: 【Mind Flay】 is only available at level 20, and shadow form is only available at level 40.

sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
DoT can now crit! Learn the first new skill 【Immolate】 and you can feel it as soon as you get started: the damage curse is split into a new category "disaster"; the 31-point peak 【Wrack】 gives the pain spell a powerful filling and absorption skill for the first time. When applied, the shadow DoT damage +10% - it is no longer the tool of 【Shadow Mastery】 with 【Shadow Bolt】.
### Exclusive mechanism
- Up DoT + Drain Fill; Core Talent 【Enhanced Drain Life】 According to the number of pain effects on the target (curse/disaster/【Corruption】, etc.), the maximum +36% is to strengthen 【Drain Life】, 【Drain Soul】 and 【Wrack】 - the main target has at least 3 pain effects permanently.

sections.markdown:
### New skills and talents
- 【Malediction】, 【Soul Harvesting】, 【Soul Siphon】, 【Disease】, 【Viciousness】, 【Wrack】 - six new skills/talents (see in-game description for details)
### Existing changes
- 【Suppression】: All-class skill hit + threat reduction - a key talent for most PvE systems
- The damage curse and the function curse are separated: 【Bane of Agony】 and 【Bane of Doom】 no longer choose one from the other; 【Curse of the Elements】 now affects the entire school (including arcane/natural/holy)!
- 【Life Tap】: Grows with the spirit; 【Curse of Recklessness】: No longer increases the damage caused by the target; 【Improved Corruption】: Increases damage at the same time; 【Drain Soul】: Jump damage also has a probability to generate soul fragments; 【Improved Bane of Agony】: 【Bane of Agony】 damage +10%; 【Fel Concentration】 and 【Curse of Exhaustion】 are also adjusted

sections.title: Pros & cons
sections.markdown:
### Advantages
- Top-level multi-target cleave (DoT spread, don't worry about monsters scattering)
- Long battles/more than two targets are the home field, and the periodic damage will be fully realized
### Disadvantages
- No burst: the damage must be accumulated hop by hop, and you cannot grab the heads of monsters with low health.
- Short battles suffer: DoT takes time
- Haste has no effect on DoT/Guide (【Soul Fire】, 【Incinerate】 are matters of other systems)
### Availability
- The group base is in a good situation: Curse and disaster are not mutually exclusive, 【Improved Shadow Bolt】 is no longer consumed by other casters; self-healing enhancement makes the "Soul Link/Life Siphon" gameplay of 【Siphon Life】 + 【Soul Link】 stronger

The 31-point peak 【Demonic Pact】 allows you to "sacrifice a demon + summon another one" and enjoy 【Demonic Sacrifice】 at the same time; pets grow with the player's attributes (details can be seen in the character panel); 【Kill】 is fast without fragments 【Soul Fire】; 【Demon Mark】 may make Voidwalker tanks possible; the pet command adds "Move to".
### Exclusive mechanism
- 【Demonic Sacrifice】 gains the "opposite" of the devil: sacrificing an imp to summon a succubus ≈ +30% shadow damage (1.15×1.03×1.10, including 【Master Demonologist】, 【Soul Link】); conversely ≈ +30% fire damage
- 【Kill】: Below 35% HP, use 【Soul Fire】 short CD, no fragmentation burst
### Getting Started
- Strong pets + high survival, leveling and PvP friendly; PvE requires keeping pets well (hide mechanism); cycle: DoT constant roll → 【Searing Pain】 maintain 【Demon Mark】 → 【Shadow Bolt】 fill → 【kill】 【Soul Fire】

- 【Unholy Power】: 20% → 10%, but the talent position has moved forward significantly
- 【Demonic Sacrifice】: Lasts 2 hours; buff correspondence changed - Imp: Shadow damage / Succubus: Fire damage / Hellhound: Life regeneration / Voidwalker: Mana regeneration
- 【Master Demonologist】: Imp is changed to increase fire damage (originally reduced threat); hellhound is changed to reduce magic damage (original total resistance)

### Disadvantages
- Pet dependence: A large piece of damage will cause it to run around with long legs - AoE and misalignment in the raid will kill it.

### Getting Started

sections.markdown:
The new skills 【Mutilate】 and 【Venom】 complete the puzzle of the 【Mutilate】 flow; the poison is fully strengthened, and the best performance is expected under high-armor targets.
### Getting Started
- The "accumulate-consumption" cycle is simple; the difficulty is to maintain high coverage of 【Slice and Dice】 and 【Venom】, and the poison layers are never exhausted

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### New skills
- 【Mutilate】: Exclusive high-quality accumulated skills, +20% damage to poisoned targets - encouraged to apply 【Deadly Poison】 on at least one weapon
- 【Venom】: New finishing move - poison damage +30%, application probability +10%; equivalent to the second 【Slice and Dice】 to manage, lacking the damage component of the later version
### Talent changes
- 【Malice】: Poison can also hit critically; 【Cold Blood】: It also takes effect on 【Mutilate】
- 【Remorseless Attacks】, 【Lethality】: Damage increase is extended to damage (the latter is 6% → 4% per point)
- 【Conspiracy】: +2% damage per point (original 1%); no longer effective against beasts/dragons
- 【Improved Expose Armor】: Reworked - each point of shaving 【Expose Armor】 consumes 5 energy, and returns 2 stars for a 5-star cast.
- 【Improved Kidney Shot】: Only increases damage to targets targeted by 【Kidney Shot】
- 【Vigor】: Talent position moved up, 2 points are the same as the upper limit
- 【Improved Poisons】: 50% probability of poison not consuming layers

sections.title: Pros & cons
sections.markdown:
### Advantages
- Poison damage ignores armor; 【Expose Armor】 is the lowest requirement (【Expose Armor】 is the lowest cost when needed)
- Complete survival skills: 【Evasion】, 【Vanish】, 【Feint】
### Disadvantages
- No team gain (【Sunder Armor】 has tied with 【Expose Armor】) - can only rely on damage and kicks to change pit positions
- Directly scrapped when encountering natural immunity/poison immunity
- Slow energy recovery (common problem in all three systems)

- Horde · Troll: Attack speed initiative and beast damage increase partial scene——【Berserk】【Rapid Regeneration】【Beast Slaying】【Regeneration】

sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
The most complete specialization in classic PvE with the least changes: it does not rely on poison/bleeding - it is not weak when encountering immune monsters. 【Blade Flurry】's cleave makes it continue to be the most practical rogue. A must-have series for everyone in the era of dual talents.
### Getting Started
- The easiest to use: just focus on one 【Slice and Dice】 and score all combo points into 【Eviscerate】

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### New talents
- 【Puncturing Wounds】: Replaces the old enhanced backstab - 【Backstab】 has a 45% probability of gaining 1 more star, and increases the critical hit rate of 【Mutilate】
- 【Perfect Execution】: 【Eviscerate】 Energy consumption -10
### Talent changes
- 【Cleave】: All weapon specializations are combined into one - axe/sword 5% extra attack, dagger/glove +5% critical hit, hammer ignores 15% armor; you don’t need to change your talents when changing weapons, and you can finally use an axe!
- 【Precision】: 5 points 5% hit → 3 points 3% hit
- 【Endurance】: 【Sprint】 and 【Evasion】 CD -30%/60% (double)
- 【Dual Wield Specialization】: 10% of off-hand damage → 5% (the cost of poison increasing with attack power)
- 【Aggression】: damage increase extended to 【Backstab】
- 【Weapon Expertise】: No more weapon skills, instead the probability of being dodged/parried is -1% per point
- Part of the energy will be returned if the skill misses (later version mechanism)

sections.title: Pros & cons
sections.markdown:

- Does not rely on poison/bleeding, and will not be immune to suppression in any situation
- The only rogue type with considerable cleave (【Blade Flurry】)
- The outbreak can be expected: 【Blade Flurry】 + 【Adrenaline Rush】 + racial active skills; survival skills 【Evasion】【Vanish】【Feint】
### Disadvantages
- No team gain (【Sunder Armor】 tied 【Expose Armor】)
- Slow energy recovery (common problem in all three systems)

- Critical hit: Linked with 【Revenge】 to amplify damage, high value

### Disadvantages
- Everything has everything: different attribute requirements, the optimal equipment often sacrifices versatility, and is still not as good as a dedicated class
- Difficult to master: There are few skills available in a single form, and top operations rely on various tricks.

sections.title: Overview
sections.markdown:
Popular treatment methods gain new angles, opening up a variety of gameplay to cope with all treatment scenarios. Note that there are "no" Life Bloom, Nourishment, Rejuvenation Bloom (effective flower) and tree form in the current skills - the impact of this blank space on full-level healing remains to be seen.
### Getting Started
- Not the most straightforward novice treatment: the core is to lay out HoT in advance - you need to predict the damage rhythm of each battle and who to kill when there is no blood loss.
- If you are used to the reactive gameplay of "see the blood loss and then press the skill", you will not adapt; the recovery druid also has direct healing skills, but what is really special is relying on HoT to save most of the group at the same time
- To put it another way, it is a treatment method that is both versatile and fun. It is worth spending time to master the HoT technique.

sections.title: What changed
sections.markdown:
### New skills and talents
- 【Wild Growth】: The famous multiplayer HoT returns but with changes - locks on the target's squad (no longer spreads nearby), 【Prayer of Healing】 who is closer to the priest
- 【Revive】: Resurrection from combat - Good news for dungeon healers, the exciting gameplay of "【Reincarnation】 with one knife in 30 minutes" comes to an end
- 【Gift of the Earthmother】: The public cooldown of 【Rejuvenation】, 【Wild Growth】, and 【Swiftmend】 is reduced to 1 second - fast HoT group building + supplement 【Wild Growth】's gameplay of catching blood loss is formed
- 【Genesis】: HoT +5% (one level of balance tree, picked up for free); 【Nature's Majesty】: Healing critical hit +4% - all HoT can now critical hit
- 【Nature's Splendor】: Extend the duration of 【Rejuvenation】 and 【Regrowth】 - strongly linked with 【Swiftmend】 (heal according to the total duration of HoT)
### Existing changes
- 【Thorns】: Retaliation damage grows with the caster's spell power
- 【Regrowth】: significantly cheaper, the HoT part can critical hit
- 【Omen of Clarity】: Basic and can be triggered by spell casting - focus on the gain to maximize 【Wild Growth】 / 【Healing Touch】 / 【Regrowth】 Extremely Blue
- 【Natural Concentration】: Restores one level of tree; affects all natural/arcane school spells - milk/output mixed or bird virtue points are valuable
- 【Subtlety】: Moved up one level, affecting all natural/arcane systems; 5 points 20% → 3 points 30% threat reduction
- 【Reflection】: Casting mana recovery 15% → 50% - the positioning of the mana recovery attribute will be re-examined
- 【Gift of Nature】: Moved up to the third floor, no more points required 【Insect Swarm】 - Unlock the powerful healing area in advance
- 【Improved Rejuvenation】: Now used to unlock 【Improved Regrowth】 (presumed to be the overall multiplication zone of 【Rejuvenation】 rather than the base value)
- 【Swiftmend】: The talent position has been greatly moved forward; the target is healed for the full duration of HoT and no longer consumes HoT by default - excellent linkage with the HoT delay effect
- 【Living Spirit】: TBC return talent, total mental multiplication area (presumably can be stacked with 【Blessing of Kings】 type gain) - a strong support for mana recovery in battle
- 【Improved Tranquility】: At the top level, the CD of 【Tranquility】 is reduced to 2 minutes - a powerful talent in the copy, non-threatening and life-saving treatment for the whole team
- 【Heart of the Wild】: Moved from the depths of the wild tree to one level, with a small investment to greatly enhance intelligence
- 【Moonglow】: Only retain the mana cost of damage reduction spells - the classic build core is no longer worth the points for recovery
- 【Nature's Grace】: Changed to 3 seconds of 10% rapidity + global cooldown reduction; forms a darning rapid style with 【Improved Regrowth】 (【Regrowth】 is woven between 【Rejuvenation】 / 【Swiftmend】), but if you click it, you will give up 【Wild Growth】 - the choice depends on the value of the group book

sections.title: Pros & cons
sections.markdown:
### Advantages
- Single target throughput: 【Healing Touch】, 【Swiftmend】, 【Regrowth】 are all strong single target treatments
- Group brushing HoT: 【Rejuvenation】, 【Swiftmend】, 【Wild Growth】 all have 1 second public cooldown, full coverage
- Blue efficiency: 【Reflection】, 【Living Spirit】, 【Omen of Clarity】 three-piece set back to blue online
- Dispersion coverage: 【Abolish Poison】 detoxification + 【Remove Curse】 - the two key pieces of the group's dispersion puzzle
- Function guarantee: 【Reincarnation】 and 【Innervate】 stabilize the team in adversity
### Disadvantages
- No magic/disease dispelling - a rare dispersal gap in the game
- HoT gameplay requires prediction, and it is easy for other healers to steal the treatment amount.
- Lack of offensive functions: all druids can only maintain 【Faerie Fire】
- Regulars on the group layoff list
